name: store-rating-platform
description: Full-stack Store Rating Platform (React + Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/backend && npm run test -w apps/frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
